import importlib.util, importlib.machinery, random
loader = importlib.machinery.SourceFileLoader("runmod", "/app/submit/run")
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_loader("runmod", loader)
R = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); loader.exec_module(R)
FULL=(1<<128)-1
def trunc(v,b): return 0 if b<=0 else (v if b>=128 else v & (FULL ^ ((1<<(128-b))-1)))
rng=random.Random(31)
bad=0
for trial in range(300):
    fib=[];seen=set()
    for _ in range(rng.randint(0,10)):
        l=rng.randint(0,128); v=trunc(rng.getrandbits(128),l)
        if (v,l) in seen: continue
        seen.add((v,l)); fib.append((v,l,rng.randint(0,65535)))
    # random cuts strictly increasing ending 128, start 0, all diffs <= some ms
    S=rng.randint(4,10)
    # random composition: pick S-1 internal cutpoints
    cps=sorted(rng.sample(range(1,128),S-1))
    cuts=[0]+cps+[128]
    ms=max(cuts[i+1]-cuts[i] for i in range(S))
    cm=R.build_costmap(fib,ms)
    st,used=R.build_stages(fib,cuts,ms)
    for i in range(S):
        if cm[(cuts[i],cuts[i+1])]!=used[i]:
            print("MISMATCH",trial,i,fib,cuts,cm[(cuts[i],cuts[i+1])],used[i]); bad+=1;break
